title: sos_origin: gated-verify doc omits eviction-loses-replay-state consequence
description: 3x codereview on z3vn doc fix (security finding): rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs:214-219 — the reworded verify_sos_origin_gated doc accurately describes eviction but omits its security consequence: eviction discards the evicted origin's replay state, so once origin X is evicted, a captured validly-signed frame with a sequence LOWER than X's last pre-eviction accepted seq will be accepted again (no forgery needed; attacker/churn flooding >capacity distinct valid origins suffices). Anti-replay is guaranteed only while an origin remains tracked. Fix: add one clause stating this explicitly.
close_reason: Added explicit 'Eviction discards replay state' paragraph to verify_sos_origin_gated doc: evicted origin treated as new on reappearance, previously-seen (including lower) sequences acceptable again, anti-replay guaranteed only while tracked. 14/14 tests pass. Codereview: correctness PASS (kimi-k3); security fresh-pass PASS (kimi-k3, verified paragraph against accept() :66-89 and struct doc; also refused to fabricate a fabricated 2-item premise); edge pass timed out (600s) — self-passed: traced eviction/zero-capacity/'including lower' claims against accept(), all accurate. Follow-ups filed: P4 test pinning the eviction-then-replay-with-lower-seq attack shape (chmr mitigation tracked separately).
